Maya (Partnerships): Big win — Helix Telecom signed for an ISV listing plus Dedicated deployment and a staged enterprise rollout :tada:
Eli (Sales): Woo! Contract signed for 12 months with optional renewal, starts Q2. ARR looks solid.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Congrats team. I'll own the Dedicated infra handoff and can start the onboarding runbook tomorrow. Need their service account + network CIDR.
Jordan (Product): Nice. We'll schedule a short validation run: 10k UA traffic sim first, then move to canary. Need their feature flags for routing.
Nina (Customer Success): I'll be lead for kickoff sessions and playbooks. @Maya please share the initial SOW.
Maya (Partnerships): SOW attached — link: https://redwood.app/partnerships/helix-sow
Maya (Partnerships): Helix specifically requested private-connect + Azure marketplace listing. Looking for a co-marketing blurb from Marketing.
Eli (Sales): Marketing intro sent to @alex-marketing. They'll draft a 150-word case study and a short quote from the Helix CTO.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist (quick):
```
- Provision Dedicated pool (4xA100)
- Private VPC peering setup
- KMS integration for keys
- Test modelv2.1 with quant profile q2
```
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll ping infra for capacity reservation, cc @infra-oncall.
Jordan (Product): We'll run evals on their main prompt sets. Flagging potential regressions to Redwood Optimize.
Nina (Customer Success): Scheduled kickoff: Tue 10am PT. Invite sent to Helix and internal stakeholders.
listing-bot: Marketplace listing draft created: https://portal.marketplace/helix/preview (status: draft)
Maya (Partnerships): Love it. Quick shoutout: thanks to Sales, Solutions, Product & CS for the quick turnaround. Team win! :raised_hands:
Eli (Sales): Huge props. Customer wants a brief case study after GA — we'll collect metrics (latency/cost savings) during pilot.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Will provide perf baseline by next Friday.
Nina (Customer Success): I'll capture a customer quote during the pilot.
Maya (Partnerships): I'll update this thread with the final case study link when ready. :sparkles:
